entries.title: NPU Offloading for Real-Time Behavioral Analysis
entries.desc: Investigating dedicated NPU hardware for running behavioral inference models at scan-time, bypassing CPU/GPU contention.
entries.findings: Intel Meteor Lake NPU achieves 1.8-2.5x inference throughput vs CPU baseline. Power efficiency gains promising for always-on scanning but driver support inconsistent.

entries.title: TPM 2.0 Remote Attestation Chain
entries.desc: Using TPM attestation to verify boot chain integrity and detect rootkit-level tampering before game launch.
entries.findings: Attestation flow works on ~87-92% of tested hardware depending on vendor. Custom BIOS and older firmware revisions require graceful fallback.

entries.title: Side-Channel Timing for VM Detection
entries.desc: Using CPU cache timing variations to detect virtual machine environments used to bypass hardware bans.
entries.findings: L3 cache timing delta identifies VMware/KVM with 92-96% accuracy depending on host config. Hyper-V detection requires additional rdtsc calibration.

entries.title: Neural Network Pruning for Edge Deployment
entries.desc: Structured pruning of behavioral detection models to reduce client-side inference cost by 60%+.
entries.findings: Magnitude pruning at 70% sparsity retains 96-97% detection accuracy. Knowledge distillation recovers ~1-2% but adds training complexity.

entries.title: GAN-Based Cheat Synthesis
entries.desc: Using generative adversarial networks to synthesize novel cheat patterns for proactive detection.
entries.findings: Initial research phase. Literature review in progress.

entries.title: UEFI Bootkit Detection via Measured Boot
entries.desc: Parsing TCG event logs and TPM PCR[7] measurements to detect unauthorized UEFI modules loaded before OS initialization.
entries.findings: TCG event log parsing successfully detects unauthorized UEFI modules on 3 of 4 test boards (ASRock, ASUS, MSI). Gigabyte board uses non-standard event log format requiring custom parser. Vendor BIOS variations introduce noise in PCR measurements — need baseline per motherboard family.

entries.title: Instrumentation Callback Injection Analysis
entries.desc: Cataloging NtSetInformationProcess(ProcessInstrumentationCallback) abuse patterns and developing kernel-level monitoring for callback registration.
entries.findings: 4 distinct callback registration patterns cataloged across known cheat loaders. Kernel-level monitoring catches new registrations in real-time but cannot detect pre-existing callbacks set before Cerberus driver loads. Investigating early-boot driver load ordering to close this gap.

entries.title: CUDA/DirectCompute Dispatch Anomaly Analysis
entries.desc: Instrumenting GPU driver layer via DXGI/Vulkan intercepts to detect unauthorized compute shader dispatches during gameplay.
entries.findings: Proof-of-concept intercept layer working via DXGI hooks. Can enumerate active compute dispatches and flag unknown shader programs. Performance overhead is a concern — naive approach adds 3-5ms per frame. Investigating selective sampling to reduce overhead to sub-1ms.
